name: Janazah Announcement
summary: Plain dark ground, no photo, no gradient, none of the food treatments. Name of the deceased, salah details, burial, and the tarji' line.

palette.note: Reads --flyer-ground / --flyer-ground-ink only. A tenant's derived ground is its brand hue desaturated to near-black, so the notice stays sombre whatever the brand is.

constraints: No photograph of the deceased, ever.
No gradient, no illustration, no accent-coloured decoration.
None of the three food treatments — no sticker outline, no white pill, no black CTA bar.
No phone number in a bar. If a contact is genuinely needed it belongs in the note, quietly.

slots.name: arabic
slots.label: Tarji' (Arabic)
slots.help: Rendered right-to-left in a system Naskh face. Check the exported image before sending — shaping depends on the device's fonts.

slots.name: translit
slots.label: Tarji' (transliteration)
slots.default: Inna lillahi wa inna ilayhi raji'un
slots.help: Kept even when the Arabic renders correctly — it is what survives a font fallback.

slots.name: intro
slots.label: Opening line
slots.default: It is with great sadness that we announce the passing of
slots.help: Confirm the wording with the family before sending.

slots.name: name
slots.label: Name of the deceased
slots.help: Spell it exactly as the family gives it. Never carry a name forward from a previous flyer.

slots.name: lifespan
slots.label: Years
slots.help: Optional, e.g. "1948 — 2026". Omit unless the family asked for it.

slots.name: burial_location
slots.label: Burial — location
slots.help: Cemetery name; add the city if it is not the masjid's own.

slots.name: burial_time
slots.label: Burial — time
slots.help: Only when it is known. An estimate that turns out wrong is worse than no line.

slots.name: note
slots.label: Closing note
slots.default: Please keep the family in your du'a.
slots.help: Also where a family contact goes, if they want one shared.

slots.name: logo
slots.label: Masjid logo
slots.help: Small, at the foot. Identification, not branding.
